msItem.colophon:
|| atha saṃvatsare smi
n_ śrīnṛpavikramāḍityarājye saṃvat 1588 varṣe pauṣadivati padāyām śānivare ghaṭikā 16 mṛgaśiranakṣatraṃ gha 11 śubhana

support.p: Leaf dimensions from title card, converted from centimetres.

lg.l: kathayaṃtaṃ hi tīrthānāṃ prabhāvān adbhutāṃs tathā |
lomaśaṃ sarvatatvajñaṃ paryapṛchad yudhiṣṭhiraḥ || 1 ||
yo rakṣet prāṇinaṃ brahman_ bhayārttaṃ śaraṇāgataṃ || 2
tasya puṇyaphalaṃ yat syāt tan me brūhi tapodhana
|| ekataḥ kratavaḥ sarvve samagravaradakṣiṇāḥ |
ekato bhayabhītasya prāṇinaḥ prāṇarakṣaṇaṃ || 3
idam eva purā devaias tulayā samatolayan |
prāṇarakṣaṇam eveha gauraveṇātiricyate || 4

atraivodāharaṃtīmam i
tihāsaṃ purātanaṃ |
iṃdrasyāgneś ca saṃvādaṃ śiver auśīnarasya ca || 5
varttamāne mahāyajñe jijñāsārthaṃ śiviṃ nṛpaṃ |

iṃdraḥ
śyenaḥ kapoto gnir bhūtvā tatraivatropajagmatuḥ || 6
athoruṃ nṛpateḥ prāpya kapotaḥ śyenajād bhayāt |

śaraṇārthaṃ mahī
pāle nililye bhayavihvalaḥ || 7
tataḥ śanair upāgamya śyenarūpī sureśvaraḥ |

rājānaṃ sumahātmānaṃ provācedaṃ vacas ta
dā || 8
|| dharmātmānaṃ purā rājan_ sarva āsan mahīkṣitaḥ |
sa tvaṃ dharmaviruddhaṃ hi kathaṃ dharmaṃ civāṃchasi
jayet kadaryaṃ dānena satyenānṛtavādinaṃ |
kṣamayā krūrakarmāṇaṃ asādhuṃ sādhunā jayet || 10

noāpakāraparoe py evam upa
kāraparo janaḥ |
ahite hitabuddhis tvaṃ sa pāpe tvam apāpakṛt | 11
doṣānveṣaṇadakṣe pi guṇānveṣaṇatatparaḥ ||

sadai
va vihito bhakṣyaḥ pīḍyamānasya me kṣudhā |
mā kāṃkṣī dharmalobhena dharmam utsṛṣṭavān asi || 13

saṃtrastarūpaḥ
prāṇārthī tvatto bhīto vihaṃgamaḥ |
matsakāśam anuprāptaḥ prāṇāgṛdhnur ayaṃ khagaḥ || 14

tad evam āgatasyāsya kapota
syābhayārthinaḥ |
katham asmadvidhāḥ kuryus tyāgaṃ sadbhir vigarhitaṃ || 15
lobhād veṣād bhayād vāpi yas tyajecharaṇāgataṃ |
brahmahatyāsamaṃ tasya pāpam āhur manīṣiṇaḥ || 16
śāstreṣu niḥkṛtir dṛṣṭā mahāpātakinām api |

śaraṇāgatahaṃtu
s tu na dṛṣṭā niḥkṛtiḥ kvacit || 17
yathātmanaḥ priyāḥ prāṇāḥ sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ tathā |

tasmān mṛtyubhayatrastās trā
tavyāḥ prāṇino budhaiḥ || 18
janmamṛtyujarārogair nityaṃ saṃsārasāgare |

jaṃtavaḥ parikliśyaṃte mṛtyos tra
syaṃti te tathā || 19
yannimittaṃ bhavechokakrodhas trāso vā krodha eva ca |
āyāso vā yato 'mūlam ekāṃham api na tyajet || 20
mariṣyāmīti yad dukhaṃ puruṣasyopajāyate |
yuktaṃ tenānumānena paro pi parirakṣituṃ || 21

yathā hi te jīvitam ātma
naḥ priyaṃ tathā pareṣām api jīvitaṃ priyaṃ |
saṃrakṣyate jīvitam ātmano yathā || tathā pareṣām api rakṣa jīvitaṃ || 22

ta
smān nāham imaṃ bhītam arppayiṣye kapotakaṃ |
yad atra yuktaṃ śyenātra manyase tad vadasva me || 23

|| ā
hārāt sarvabhūtāni sambhavaṃti nareśvara
āhāreṇa vivarddhaṃte tena jīvaṃti jaṃtavaḥ || 24

śakyate 'nnair vināpy arthai rā
yan varttayituṃ ciraṃ |
na tv āhāravihīnena śakyaṃ varttayituṃ kvacit || 25

bhakṣyād vināpi hi śitān mama prāṇā
rvvisām pate |
visṛjya kāyaṃ yāsyaṃti paṃthānam apunarbhavaṃ || 26
mṛte ca mayi sarvaṃ me putrādāraṃ mariṣyati |

rakṣamā
ṇaḥ kapotaṃ tvaṃ bahūn prāṇān na rakṣasi || 27
dharmaṃ yo bādhate dharmo na sa dharmaḥ paraṃtapa ||

avirodhī ca yo dharmaḥ sa dharmaḥ
sadbhir iṣyate || 28
tasmā virodhadharmasya viciṃtya gurulāghavaṃ |
yato bhūyas tato rāja kuru dharmavinirṇṇayaṃ || 2
|| bahukalyāṇasaṃyuktaṃ bhāṣase vihagottama |
suparṇṇaḥ pakṣirāṭ tvaṃ hi dharma eva na saṃsayaḥ || 30 ||

ta
thā hi dharmasaṃyuktaṃ bahucitraṃ prabāṣase |
na te hy aviditaṃ kiṃcid iti tvāṃ lakṣayāmy ahaṃ || 31

nāsmā dharmmo paro bhūyaḥ
kaścid anyo sti khecara |
prāṇināṃ bhayabhītānām abhayaṃ yat pradīyate || 32

varam ekasya satvasya dadyādabhayadakṣi
ṇā |
na tu viprasahasrasya gosahasrasya yat phalaṃphalaṃ kṛtaṃ || 33
abhayaṃ sarvabhūtebhyo yo dadāti dayāparaḥ |

tasya dehād vi
muktasya na bhayaṃ vidyate kvacit || 34
hemadhenugavādīdharādānāṃ dātāraḥ sulabhā bhuvi |

durlabhaḥ puruṣo loke sarvabhūtā'
bhayapradaḥ || 35
mahatām api yajñānāṃ kālena kṣīyate phalaṃ |
bhītābhayapradānasya kṣaya eva na vidyate || 36

dattam i
ṣṭaṃ tapas taptaṃ tīrthasevā śrutaṃ tathā |
sarvvāṇy abhayadānasya kalāṃ nārhaṃti ṣoḍaśīṃ || 37

catuḥsāgaraparyaṃtāṃ yo dadyā
t pṛthivīm imāṃ
abhayaṃ yaś ca bhūtebhyas tayor abhayado dhikaḥ || 38
api tyajed rājyam imaṃ śarīraṃ vā sudustyajaṃ |
na tv imaṃ bhayasaṃtrastaṃ tyaje dīnaṃ kapotakaṃ || 39
yan mayopārjitaṃ kiṃcichubhaṃ janmani janmani |

bhavet trātā¦
bhayārttānāṃm avināśāya dehināṃ || 40
na hy ahaṃ kāmayed rājyaṃ na svargaṃ nāpunarbhavaṃ |

prāṇināṃ duḥkhataptānāṃ kā
maye duḥkhanāśanaṃ || 41
yathā ca nānṛtāṃ vācam aham evam udāhare |
satyena tena bhagavān_ prasīdatu maheśvaraḥ || 4
āhārārthe samāraṃbhas tava cāyaṃ vihaṃgama |
tad yatheṣṭaṃ tavāhāraṃ manyase taṃ dadāmy ahaṃ || 43

ya
eva vihito smākaṃ dhātrā bhakṣyaḥ kapotakaḥ |
tam enaṃ bhakṣyam ātmānaṃ dehi me dya nareśvara || 44

śyenāḥ kapotā vā
khādaṃtivādhaṃti śrutir eṣā sanātanī |
mā rājana sāram ajñātvā kadalīskaṃdadham āruha || 45

nāhaṃ kuśāstra
mārgeṇa kvacid vartte vihaṃgama |
śāstrair evopadiṣṭo yaṃ dharmaḥ satyadayāparaḥ || 46

sarvasatveṣu yad dānam ekasatveṣu yā
dayā
sarvasatvapradānāt tu dayaivaikā viśiṣyate || 47
sarve vedā na tat kuryuḥ sarve yajñāś ca khecara |

sarvatīrthābhi
ṣekaś ca yat kuryāt prāṇināṃ dayā || 48
vāṅmanaḥkarmabhir ye tu sarvabhūtahite ratāḥ |

dayādāṃtāś ca puṇyāś ca brahmalo
kaṃ vrajaṃtibrahmalokābhigatāḥ pā॰ te || 49
dhyānayogaparā nityaṃ yāṃ gatiṃ yāṃti yoginaḥ |
tām eva gachati naraḥ sarvasatvahite rataḥ || 50
gachatas tiṣṭato vāpi jāgrataḥ svapito pi vā |

yan na bhūta hi tīrthāyasarvabhūtahitārthāya sad e
vair iva ceṣṭitaṃ || 51
jaṃgamāni ca bhūtāni sthāvarāṇi ca ye narāḥ |

ātmavat parirakṣaṃti te yāṃ
ti paramāṃ gatiṃ || 52
prāṇinaṃ vadhyamānaṃ ca yaḥ kaścit samupekṣate |

sa yāti narakaṃ ghora
m iti prāhur mmanīṣiṇaḥ || 53
rājyaṃ ca sakalaṃ satyaṃ prayachāmi tava dvija |

yadi kāmaya
se hy enaṃ varjayitvā kapotakaṃ || 54

yadi rājan kapote te sudṛḍhā bhaktir ī
dṛśī |
tatvaṃ kapotatulyāni svamāṃsāni prayaccha me || 55

anugraham imaṃ manye ya
n māṃse śyenābhibhāṣase |
etat te haṃ prayachāmi svamāṃsaṃ vāyāvad ichasi || 56

yad apriyaṃ tat svajanaś cirād vada
ti vā na vā |
mama tu priyam evaitat kasmād abhihitaṃ cirāt || 57
adhruveṇa śarīreṇa pratikṣaṇavināśinā
dhruvaṃ yo nārjayed dharmmaṃ sa śocyo mūḍhcetanaḥ || 58
yadi prāṇyupakārāya deho yaṃ nopayujyate |

tataḥ kim upacāro sya
pratyahaṃ kṛkriyate vṛthā || 59
|| nātiriktam ahaṃ yāce tava māṃsaṃ nareśvara |

tasmāt kapotena samaṃ praya
cha tulayā dhṛtam || 60
tad evāhaṃ kariṣyāmi yan māṃsenābhiyācase |

yenāsya rakṣaṇaṃ me syāt tad vadasva
vihaṃgama || 61
|| evam uktvā svamāṃsāni samuchetyadya sa pārthivaḥ |

prahṛṣṭas tolayāmāsa kapo
tena saha prabhuḥ ||| 62
tyaktvātmasukhabhogechāṃ sarvasatvasukhaiṣiṇaḥ |
bhavaṃti paraduḥkhena sādhavo nityaduḥkhitāḥ |
dhṛyamānas tu tulayā kapoto vyatiricyate |
punaś cotkṛtya māṃsāni rājan prādāt sa pārthivaḥ || 64

na vidyate yadya
māṃsaṃ kapotena samaṃ kvacit |
tataḥ prakṣīṇamāṃso sāv āruroha tulāṃ svayaṃ || 65

parasukhāya svaṃ duḥkhaṃ sarvabhū
tahite ratāḥ |
nopekṣaṃte mahātmānaḥ svaśarīre mahaty api || 66athātmāgnitvāt sādhute paraṃ śṛtān_ vṛkṣate cātapaḥ svayaṃ ||
atha tasmin_ samārūḍhe tulām auśīṇare nṛpe |

de
vaduṃdubhayo neduḥ puṣpavṛṣṭiḥ papāta ca || 67
tatas tasya tadā matvā devarājo dhṛtiṃ parāṃ |

śakraḥ svarūpam āsthāya vākya
m etad abhāṣata || 68
|| iṃdro ham asmi bhadraṃ te kapoto havyavāhanaḥ |

jijñāsamānau rājaṃn_s tvā
m imaṃ yajñam upāgatau || 7
naitat pūrvve nṛpāś cakrur na kariṣyaṃti cāpare |
mahākāruṇikeneha yat kṛtaṃ duṣkaraṃ tvayā || 71

parā
rthe tyajataḥ prāṇān yā prītir abhavat tava |
prāṇasaṃśayaralubdheṣu na sā prāṇeṣu dehināṃ || 72

parārthaikāṃtakadhiyaḥ svārthe
cātyaṃtaniṣṭurā
tvayy eva kevalā rājan karuṇākaruṇāyate || 73
svakarmmapāśaiḥ sudṛḍhaṃ baddhaṃ kṛtsnam idaṃ jagat |

tvaṃ ja
gadduḥkhamokṣārthaṃ baddhaḥ karuṇayā nṛpa || 74
yathā sarvvārthatā vāpi doṣeṣu praekāṃtakadhi aikacittadvikṛtaṃ tvayā ||

tatha caivātmasaṃtrāṇe vāsanāpi
niśeṣitāna vidyate pā॰ || 75
akṛte rṣyā viśiṣṭeṣu hīnānāṃ nāvamanyase
agatvā sadṛśe sparddhāṃ tvaṃ lokottamatāṃ gata || 76

paro
pakārajanmāno vidhātrā vihitāś ca ye |
sajalājaladās tvaṃ ca saphalāś ca mahādrumāḥ || 77

ātmaprāṇaiḥ paraprāṇān
yo naraḥ parirakṣati |
sa yāti paramaṃ dhāma yato nāvarttate punaḥ || 78
prāṇair api tvayā rājan_ rakṣitaḥ kṛpaṇo yataḥ |

sva
māṃsāny api dattāni dravyeṣv anyeṣu kā kathā || 79
paśavo pi hi jīvaṃti kevalātmodaraṃbharāḥ |

sa punar jīvita ślā
ghyo yaḥ parārthe hi jīvati || 80
kim atra citraṃ yat saṃtaḥ parānugrahatatparāḥ |
na hi svadehaśītāya jāyaṃte caṃdanadrumāḥ || 81
paropakāravyāpāraparo yaḥ puruṣaḥ sadā
sapadaṃ tad avāpnoti parād api hi yat paraṃ || 82

paropakāraikarasāḥ svasukhāya
gataspṛhāḥ |
jagaddhitāya jāyaṃte dhasādhas tv tv ādṛśā bhuvi || 82
yat svamāṃsāni gātrebhya samuchittāni pārthiva |

eṣā
te śāśvatī kīrttiḥ sā te nānugāmiṣyati || 84
devarūpadharaś caiva pālaya tvaṃ ca medhinīṃ |

sarvalokān atikramya brahma
lokaṃ gamiṣyasi || 85
|| evam uktvā tam iṃdrāgnī jagmatus tridaśālayaṃ |

rājā śata kratuṃ dṛṣṭvā mu
mude devavac ciraṃ || 86
idaṃ yaḥ śṛṇuyān nityaṃ śiveś caritam uttamaṃ |
sa vidhūyeha pāpāni prayāti tridivaṃ naraḥ || 87

viciṃ
tya rājā svaśarīram adhruvaṃ dhruvaṃ yaśaḥ sarvajanasya durllabhaṃ |

śarīradānāt parajīvarakṣaṇaṃ vidhāya lokatrayabhūṣaṇaṃ
yayau || 88
